name: Aurral Classical
description: Tags classical music as Composer — Soloist — Ensemble — Conductor from MusicBrainz, compares recordings of a movement, and downloads classical albums from slskd.
uses: Tags of classical files in your Library

settings.label: MusicBrainz mirror
settings.help: Optional, like http://musicbrainz.lan:5000. A mirror isn't limited to 1 request a second.

settings.label: slskd URL
settings.help: Like http://slskd:5030. Needed for the download source.

settings.label: slskd download folder
settings.help: slskd's downloads folder, as Aurral sees it. Finished files are copied from here.

settings.label: Name order
settings.help: Roles in the artist tag, in order. Default: composers, arrangers, soloists, ensembles, conductors

settings.label: Separator
settings.help: Goes between the names in the artist tag. Default: —

settings.label: Recordings to compare
settings.help: How many recordings Compare recordings puts in a playlist. Default 10, at most 25.
